name: Batchwell
summary: A back office for a small brand that makes, sells and ships its own products
about: A nine-page back office for makers, shown with a skincare studio in Lahore. A shelf of jars fills to show stock, batches turn ingredients into products with lot codes and best-before dates, and orders flow from a form to a drag-and-drop shipping board. Good for skincare, candle, soap and food makers.
how: Open a page from the sidebar; on a phone the menu button opens it.
On Overview, click a jar on the shelf to see that product, its recipe and how many more you can make.
Press Make a batch, pick a product and quantity: the ingredient bars show what you have, and starting the batch pours the jars and moves the stock.
Save a new order: stock comes off the shelf straight away and the bell warns you when a product drops to its reorder level.
On Shipping, drag an order card to the next column (or use Move), and book a pickup for every packed parcel.
Receive ingredient deliveries with a lot number and best-before date; expiring lots are flagged in the list.
Switch Reports between 7D, 30D and 12M, and use Settings to change alerts, the theme or reset the demo data.
